notes:
Added
- See it before it's made: every change in the Style Studio and in Clip Review now waits as "Unapplied changes" until you choose "Apply changes", which makes the clip once with all of them. "Discard changes" drops them. Unapplied changes are kept when you move to another screen or close Kirinuki, and Kirinuki asks before you leave a screen that has some.
- Real previews of the clip as it will be made: a frame at the playhead that updates as you change things, a row of 8 to 12 frames across the whole clip, the whole clip with its sound in a quick low-resolution version, any section at full speed, and before/after, split and side-by-side comparisons with another style.
- Move the watermark, the captions, the hook card and the picture by dragging them on the preview, or with the arrow keys. They stay clear of the platform's buttons when "Snap to safe zone" is on, and the preview shows where each one really ends up.
- Remove the show's music from a clip while keeping the voices and sound effects, or replace it with a track from your own music library. Your music plays quieter whenever someone speaks. A quality check makes sure the voices are still clear and says how much music is left; when it isn't good enough, the clip keeps its original sound and tells you so. Listen to the original and the new sound side by side before you apply it.
- Settings → Music: keep your own music with its source, licence and credit. Kirinuki only accepts licences that allow use in monetised videos, adds the credit to the clip's description when the licence asks for it, and refuses tracks it can't use.
- The music-removal models (Bandit v2 and YAMNet) are downloaded the first time you turn music removal on, from Kirinuki's own release page, and checked before use. The licence list in About now includes them, with the credit the Bandit v2 model's licence asks for.

Fixed
- If Kirinuki can't open its data, it no longer asks for a Repair that can't help. A new screen says what is wrong in plain words and offers the right fix: "Try again" when another program or a full disk is in the way, "Start fresh" when the data itself can't be used (the old data is set aside, never deleted; finished clips, downloads and your logo, font and music files stay), "Restore my previous data" when a good backup exists, or Repair when Kirinuki's own files are damaged. A Repair that already failed the same way is never offered again.
- Before updating its data to a new version, Kirinuki now checks that the data is exactly what it expects, and puts the previous copy back if the update fails, so a failed update can't leave the data half-changed.
- Test builds of Kirinuki now use their own name, data folder and install folder, so they can never touch the data of the Kirinuki you use.
- Trimming a clip that is longer than your clip-length range no longer shortens it to the range: a small nudge now stays a small nudge, as the trim bar shows.
